title: Nutty Creamy Spanish Morbier Pa Amb Tomaquet
description: A yeasty and creamy Spanish dish featuring morbier cheese, perfect for a brunch mood, made with mantecare emulsification and vegetarian friendly ingredients, served as pa amb tomaquet.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine yeast, flour, and warm water, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a large rectangle.
Spread the diced tomato and minced garlic over the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Arrange the sliced morbier cheese over the top of the tomato and garlic.
Drizzle the olive oil over the cheese and sprinkle with chopped almonds and kosher salt.
Bake the pa amb tomaquet in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the pa amb tomaquet from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
